result.topic_en: Ramanujan states series identities: an alternating series in d(n) expressed via sech terms, Dirichlet-series products of zeta and L-functions giving divisor sums σ_r(n), and residue-derived partial-fraction identities with αβ=π² leading to a transformation formula for Σ n/(e^{2nα}−1); the page is crossed through with diagonal lines.

methods.what: Alternating series in odd-index divisor function d(n) equals a series of hyperbolic secants
Dirichlet series of divisor sum σ_r(n) as product of zeta functions
Product of Dirichlet L-series (character mod 4) giving alternating odd divisor-sum series
Partial-fraction identity via residues with coth terms, αβ=π²
Analogous alternating sech partial-fraction identity with αβ=π²/4
Transformation formula for Lambert-type series Σ k/(e^{2kα}−1) (Eisenstein E2 transformation), obtained by equating coefficients of 1/n
